# numinia-engine (working name)
> Thin AGPL-3.0 web 3D/XR engine in TypeScript. It draws, syncs, simulates and loads data; it knows nothing of any game. Node >= 24 runs the .ts files directly (erasable TypeScript only, imports end in .ts).

## Layers (enforced by tools/layers.mjs, rules in tools/layers.json)
core -> schema -> ecs -> sim -> net -> feature -> {client, instance} -> agent -> server; {instance} -> cli; render talks to three.js only.
Game features live in features/<id>/ and may import only core, schema and feature; only the composition roots
(packages/server/src/main.ts, packages/cli/src/describe.ts, apps/) import features/.

## Packages (each has a README.md with: is, does not, depends on, tested by, API)
- `core` — Q16.16 fixed point, seeded RNG (xorshift), FNV-1a hash, `Result`/`Issue` types. Deps: nothing. [packages/core/README.md]
- `schema` — One description per component/message: defaults, validation with error paths, bits per field. Deps: core. [packages/schema/README.md]
- `ecs` — Entities with generation counters and component columns (one Int32Array per field). Deps: core, schema. [packages/ecs/README.md]
- `sim` — Deterministic 20 Hz step over integers: avatars, movement, snapshot, state hash, replay, the reference fingerprint. Deps: core, schema, ecs. [packages/sim/README.md]
- `net` — Bit packing, quantized snapshots (6 bytes per visible entity on the ground, 8 in the air; your own vertical state exact; wire format 2), files over HTTP (`ficheros.ts`: kinds, caps, byte checks), area of interest with a priority cap K, message types (9 = REPORT, the page's session report; 10 = IDENTITY, the guest token; 12 = PASE, numinia.com's world pass, own 2048-byte cap, H3b), `Transport` + in-memory loopback + WebSocket client, schema codec (`writeFields`/`readFields`). Deps: core, schema, ecs, sim. [packages/net/README.md]
- `feature` — The plug for game features: `defineFeature` (intents, events, shared state, all by schema; accessibility built in: `spoken` verbs, `announce` events, `state.card` things — refused otherwise; S4: `state.persist` and a server-only `store` survive restarts; J9: state set with `at` is a thing in the world that reaches only players within `state.radius`; H1: `api.puede(entity, "construir")` asks the server for permission, `view.place` draws a model by its sha256, a card with an empty name is decoration; H9: `api.activo(sha, ext)`; J3: `api.listen` hears other features' events, scope "server", `api.visible(entity)`), the catalog sent on join (what agents read as verbs), `ServerRuntime` and `ClientRuntime`. Deps: core, schema, net. [packages/feature/README.md] Recipe: docs/EXTENDER.md.
- `client` — Session on the player's side: prediction of the own avatar, interpolation of others (150 ms in the past), reconnection to the server URL, the game features' client runtime. Deps: core, schema, ecs, sim, net, feature. [packages/client/README.md]
- `render` — The only package that talks to three.js: WebGPU/WebGL2 view, power policy (frame cap, dynamic resolution, battery), crowds (baked VAT), AR and VR sessions (AR: the live plaza in miniature on your table; VR: dialogue panel, notes), your hands in XR (`manos.ts`: a hand on each controller, tracked hands, reach + ray, J10), what the page reports about the device (`sesion.ts`), the mouse camera (`view.cam`, N1), the builder's gizmo (`view.editor`, `view.pick`, `view.puntoBajo`, M22), VRM avatars (`avatares*.ts`, J1; three-vrm loaded after the first frame), names and speech bubbles (`nombres.ts`, J3). Deps: three.js (+ @pixiv/three-vrm, lazy). [packages/render/README.md]
- `instance` — The authoritative loop: connects any `Transport`, applies one input per tick, sends snapshots; `Bot` speaks the real protocol headless; hosts the game features' server runtime. Deps: core, schema, ecs, sim, net, feature. [packages/instance/README.md]
- `agent` — AI inhabitants (P4) as players: `Cuerpo` enters by the same protocol with an agent ticket (MOTOR_AGENTES_SECRET; the server names it «<name> · IA»), walks by inputs, speaks and gestures through catalog verbs, reads what a page has (`sentidos()`: untrusted names and words only inside one `<material>` fence); `Guion` = escalón E0 (route, greetings, answers when called, short orders in code, never answers an AI; no LLM); `Mente` = escalones E2/E4 (P5a): when called by name it asks Claude (`cerebro.ts`, key CEREBRO_CLAVE, caps, echo brain for tests) with what it sees in `<material>`, and carries out the tools it proposes only after checking them in code (gesture, walk, follow; place/move/scale/delete/undo objects if the world lets it build); no key or a cap → the script; `main.ts` = the service `numinia-habitantes`, apart from the engine, reading `habitantes/*.json` (`habitante@1`; optional `cerebro.modelo` and `cerebro.tope` = that inhabitant's model and calls per UTC day, never a key) of the adventure. Deps: core, schema, ecs, sim, net, feature, client, instance. [packages/agent/README.md]
- `server` — `startServer()`: HTTP `/health` `/metrics` `/metrics.prom` `/sesiones` + `/a/<sha256>.<ext>` (files of things in the world: the house library `activos/`, CC0, and uploads in ACTIVOS_DIR; `PUT` by builders with their guest token, `subidas.ts`, H9; `vrm.ts` reads a VRM's licence and triangles) + the world's roles (H3: numinia.com's STD-052 roles, `roles.ts` + `roles-mundo.ts`, chat orders /roles /dueño /dar /silenciar /echar /vetar /agente; `api.puede` asks them; H3b: `pase.ts` checks numinia.com's Ed25519 world pass — MOTOR_PASE_CLAVE, MOTOR_PASE_MUNDO, MOTOR_PASE_ORG — and a good pass replaces that person's roles) + outside AI agents by public key (ADR-080: `aventura/agentes/<id>.json`, `agente@1`; signed a2 tickets, `puerta.ts`; an AI only enters and builds; bridge `tools/mcp-mundo.ts`, MCP over stdio; keys `tools/agente.ts`; IAs of a numinia.com organization (ia-organizacion): a pass with `kind:"agent"`, `state:"activa"|"dormida"`, `sub a_…` enters as `ia-a_…`; the connection lives only while its pass is valid (4003 at `exp` unless a fresh PASE arrived; asleep = no building); the bridge asks `POST {NUMINIA_URL}/api/agents/pass` every ~8 min (`packages/agent/src/pase-org.ts`, README) either signed with the agent's key (AGENTE_CLAVE) or, the easy way, with an access token `AGENTE_TOKEN=ntk_…` as `Authorization: Bearer` + body `{org, agent, aud}` (a 401 is final: token wrong or renewed; the token is never printed); `/status` has `mundoPase`; `GET /agentes` also lists connected ones with `organizacion: true`; `GET|POST /agentes` and `DELETE /agentes/<id>` = the same management over HTTP for numinia.com's owner panel, `agentes-http.ts`: `Authorization: Bearer <world pass>` with `manage-organization` or owner, 401/403/404 when no pass key is set, CORS only for https://numinia.com, one code path with `/agente` in `roles-mundo.ts`) + `/mundo` (the world as a zip, `numinia-engine/mundo@2`: datos/ + aventura/ + entorno/ + mundo.json, plus compose.yml/arrancar.sh/LEEME.txt to run it yourself; download and upload with the administration code, `mundo-zip.ts` over a dependency-free `zip.ts`; the upload is checked whole, swapped in and the server restarts) + `/status` (C4: uptime, conectados, commitHash, version; + nombre, descripcion, portada and the world's look `tema` from the adventure's `ficha.json`, `ficha@1`) + the built page itself when WWW_DIR is set (`pagina.ts`, C1) + the features' routes + WebSocket on one port, session log (how each player entered: device, browser, XR, frames; `npm run sesiones`), the features' saved data (`datos.ts`: DATOS_DIR/<feature>.json + .jsonl; `leerFoto`/`repetirDiario` fold them for read-only tools; `npm run concesiones` lists the quests' grants as CSV), tick/runtime metrics, measuring bots, load swarm with reports (docs/MEDIDAS.md), CPU bench. One folder is the whole world (`mundo-carpeta.ts`, MOTOR_MUNDO: datos/ aventura/ entorno/ sesiones/; keys MOTOR_SECRET|JWT_SECRET and MOTOR_ADMIN|ADMIN_CODE, else claves.env made once). The container image (`Dockerfile`, built from the installer) enters by `entrada.ts`: the server, or `copia`|`comprobar`|`importar` (`mundo-cli.ts`). Deps: core, schema, ecs, sim, net, instance, feature. [packages/server/README.md]
- `cli` — Command line over a headless instance: `run` (fingerprint + timings, feeds the gates) and `describe` (readable JSON of a world; `--catalogo` for the features). Deps: core, schema, ecs, sim, net, instance, feature. [packages/cli/README.md]

## Commands
- npm test            unit tests (< 1 s)
- npm run gates       tests + layers + determinism + bandwidth + 1,000-person tick (a few s). Run before committing.
- npm run describe -- --bots 6 --ticks 100 --seed 42   JSON of a headless world: entities, positions (m), who sees whom
- npm run describe -- --catalogo   what the game features offer: verbs (intents) with their fields, events, state
- npm run run -- --ticks 2000 --bots 50   fingerprint + timings
- npm run server / dev / bots / e2e   plaza server, page, headless players, browser check
- npm run banco       graphics bench: GPU/CPU ms, draw calls, fill-rate probe per technique (apps/banco, docs/BANCO-GRAFICO.md; needs a GPU, never a gate)

## Contracts you must not break
- Determinism: sim uses integers / Q16.16 only; no Math.random, Date, Map/Set iteration to decide. See docs/DETERMINISM.md.
- Reference fingerprint is pinned in test/engine.test.ts; changing it, the wire format or a file format is a FORMAT CHANGE (AGENTS.md, Autonomy).
- Game features never touch the simulation: their state lives outside it and never enters the fingerprint.
- Validation returns Result with error paths; it never throws.

## Limits and numbers
limits.json (schema numinia-engine/limits@1) is the machine form; docs/FICHA-TECNICA.md the human one. Every number is `measured` (names its test) or `estimated` (names its source).

## More
Things placed in the world (H1, M22): features/objetos (place, move, turn, duplicate, pin, name, delete, undo, redo; whether @todos builds is stored in the world's roles: MOTOR_CONSTRUIR=todos only seeds a new world, then an owner's /construir todos|nadie), models in activos/ listed in features/objetos/biblioteca.json; the builder panel and keys in apps/plaza/constructor.ts. Holes (U12): a picture in a frame that waits for a work — verbs hueco/rellenar/vaciar; the server measures an uploaded image (api.medidas) and fits it (encajar); click or E opens the file picker: apps/plaza/huecos.ts.
Movement wheel (J7b): the moves are data in features/gestos/movimientos.ts (clips from activos/animaciones, UAL1 CC0), the wheel apps/plaza/rueda.ts (hold G), its arithmetic packages/client/src/rueda.ts, the avatar side view.movimiento (packages/render/src/avatares*.ts).
Chat, bubbles and names (J3): features/chat, apps/plaza/chat.ts. Typing never moves: every page key listener asks apps/plaza/escribiendo.ts.
Jump and run (J2): packages/sim (groundHeight is the hook for physics, M6). House avatars and animations (J1): activos/avatares, activos/animaciones, converter tools/vrma/.
Settings (N2): every setting is data — engine (packages/client/src/ajustes-motor.ts), features (`ajustes` in defineFeature), worlds (mundo.ajustes.json); registry packages/client/src/ajustes.ts, device capabilities capacidades.ts, menu apps/plaza/menu-ajustes.ts; agents use window.__numinia.ajustes.
Density dial (U20): Mínimo · Normal · Completo, setting `interfaz.densidad`, key U; the table of panels is packages/client/src/densidad.ts (keys `densidad`/`cuando`, the ones `marco@1` will carry), applied by apps/plaza/densidad.ts + CSS in tema.css (data-densidad attributes).
Frames (U3, minimum): the same table also carries each panel's box (`caja`: anchor + offsets + size), glass (`cristal`) and compact-screen change; `cssMarcos()` makes the one stylesheet (apps/plaza/marcos.ts, wide screens only). Clock beside the minimap: apps/plaza/reloj.ts + packages/client/src/reloj.ts, setting `interfaz.hora` (local/UTC). Visible notices stack (≤ 3, 6 s): apps/plaza/avisos.ts, fed by `anunciar`.
Quests and people (J5): an adventure is a folder of text files (aventuras/<name>/, AVENTURA_DIR; mision@1, pnj@1, cosa@1, secuencia@1 (`secuencias/<id>.json`: a short scripted moment — a person moves, extra models show, lines and house sounds — played only on the pages of the player whose step names it, U14 (5)), habitante@1, and an optional ficha.json `ficha@1`: the world's name, description, cover and `tema` — its page's colours and title face, applied by apps/plaza/tema-mundo.ts), checked with `node tools/aventura.ts`; engine in features/misiones; quest steps: llega_a, habla_con, recibe (a person gives you a thing), usa, coge, entrega (`cosa`, or `cosas` to deliver several at once), and consecutive steps with the same `grupo` are done in any order (the player sees «Piezas reunidas 1/3»); any step may name a `secuencia` (played when it is done) and an `espera` (1–60 s before it can be done, counted by the server's clock from when its block began; saved with the progress); a person may have a trade (pnj@1 `oficio`, a second line under the name) and the server marks people and quest things for each player («!» something for you now, «✓» done: `marcas()` in maquina.ts, event `misiones.marcas`, drawn by the labels and the maps); a cosa@1 may look different for whoever already used it (`apariencia.usada` { modelo, escala? }: decided by each page from its own book, so the chest is open only for who opened it), completing a quest with `recompensas` writes one grant per guest with identity into the misiones store (`c:<quest>:<guest>`, never overwritten; organizers list them as CSV with `npm run concesiones -- <world folder> [quest]`), and the page shows a «Misión completada» banner (U14 (6)); things used from close by declare `interact` (J4). Vertical worlds: pnj@1/cosa@1 `posicion.y` and `llega_a` `y` (0–30 m); reach also asks the height (`api.within`, `reachable(x, z, y)`, `ALCANCE_ALTURA_M` = 2.5 m in packages/feature).
Map and player sheet (J5): apps/plaza/mapa.ts, ficha.ts; arithmetic packages/client/src/mapa.ts; top-down picture packages/render/src/cenital.ts.
The Graboso (M18b): the relic that records what you see — K or the «Graboso» button takes it out and records the engine's canvas (`captureStream`) + your microphone with MediaRecorder, hard cap 30–60 s, the clip downloads locally (UTC name); pure cycle packages/client/src/graboso.ts, head over the shoulder packages/render/src/graboso.ts (lazy), page apps/plaza/graboso.ts; joins the inventory (Y1) when Y1 lands. Design: ../mmo-browser-study/GRABOSO-DISENO.md.
Fishing (pesca v2): features/pesca (server-owned cycle cast → wait → nibble → bite window → tension fight at 20 Hz → catch; `fin` carries the fish to whoever is near; fish table peces.json; per-guest basket in the store; a world's spots in MUNDO_DIR/pesca.json); page apps/plaza/pesca.ts (HUD, big «Recoger», «¡Pescado!» panel with chime) and packages/render/src/pesca.ts (pond with 1-draw-call TSL water + ripples, bank, boardwalk, «Pesca» sign, rod in the avatar's hand, low-poly fish that jumps to the hand; lazy). docs/EXTENDER.md «Pesca».
Darts (dardos v1): features/dardos (a board is a thing of the world; a turn = 3 darts; `lanzar {sitio, x, y, fuerza}` sends where you aimed on the face and how hard; the server bends it — weak drops, hard climbs and scatters, a tick-hashed hand tremor — and scores sector/ring/points; `jugar` starts a turn, `salir`/walking away/idle 60 s close it; per-guest scoreboard in the store; a world's boards in MUNDO_DIR/dardos.json). Page: apps/plaza/dardos.ts (throwing view: mouse on a PC, flick on a phone), 3D boards and the AR minigame on your real wall packages/render/src/dardos.ts (wall hit-test; JuegoAR in ar.ts), painter packages/render/src/diana.ts; e2e tools/e2e-piernas/dardos.mjs (PC, phone, IWER AR). docs/EXTENDER.md «Dardos».
Dice (dados v1): features/dados (the SERVER rolls: `tirar {sitio, dados: "2d6+1", oculta}`; each die from crypto.getRandomValues with rejection sampling, numbered rolls `n`, the same values to everyone within CERCA_M 30 m; hidden rolls tell the others THAT, never WHAT; a dice tower is a thing of the world with `interact` «tirar los dados» and its last roll in state, from MUNDO_DIR/dados.json; chat `/tirar 2d6`). Page: apps/plaza/dados.ts (dice card, tower buttons; label over the roller's head). Tests test/dados.test.ts. docs/EXTENDER.md «Dados».
Environment and elements (H4, H8, H12): features/entorno (entorno@1; its optional `aparicion` {x, z, radio} says where people appear and goes to the sim's `spawnAvatar` through `InstanceOptions.aparicion`, never on the wire; `mapa.corte` (m, U14) cuts both maps at that height — a floor plan inside a building — and the world's file says it again at each start), features/elementos (water, fire, smoke, dust); render packages/render/src/entorno.ts, calidad.ts (quality by device tier), particulas.ts, elementos.ts.
Game Director (N6): features/director — who may direct (action `dirigir` = STD-052 `manage-rituals`; Moderación holds it; AIs never, PERMISOS_IA) puts scenes (escena@1, `aventura/escenas/<id>.json`: `nombre`, optional `preset` (a house preset) and/or `entorno` (a partial entorno@1 without suelo/aparicion/mapa) and `narracion` (≤ 280 bytes); applied by features/entorno over the world's own entorno.json, so no leftovers; the house presets are scenes too), narrates a line to everyone (`narracion`, the page's #narrador banner) and summons people to where they stand (`convocatoria`: each page answers `acudir` yes/no, «Ir» only lights a beacon — nobody is moved; only the caller gets the counts). Also from the chat: /escenas, /escena <name|number>, /narrar <text>, /convocar [text]. Directors may also `ajustar` the environment live. Page: apps/plaza/director.ts (button «Dirigir», key K). Checked by `node tools/aventura.ts`. Design and later cuts (give things, show/hide, per-object grip, VR wrist menu, AI assistant/AI director): docs/BACKLOG.md N6.
Web screens (N17): features/web — a panel of the world that shows a real web page. On PC and phone the page lays an iframe over the panel with CSS 3D transforms (packages/render/src/web.ts, three.js CSS3DRenderer loaded with the first screen; live only within 16 m, in front, no solid box in between); in VR there is no DOM in the headset's picture, so the panel is a preview card whose «Abrir fuera de VR» (ray + trigger) leaves VR and shows the link (apps/plaza/web.ts). The server asks each site once whether it may be framed (X-Frame-Options / CSP frame-ancestors → state `marco`: «si», «no», «?» or the source list; the page decides with `dejaEnmarcar` and its own origin); a refusing site (numinia.org today) is a card with «Abrir» everywhere. Safety: the world's allow-list `entorno/web.json` (numinia-engine/web@1: `dominios`, `pantallas`), https only (http only for loopback), never the engine's origin, iframe sandbox without top navigation, Permissions Policy with no camera/microphone/geolocation, no referrer. Intents `poner` / `quitar` (owners and the Game Director: action `dirigir`); chat /web, /web <url> [título], /web quitar <id>. Checked by test/web.test.ts and tools/e2e-piernas/web.mjs (serves its own pages: no network).
Economy design simulator (internal tool, not wired to the engine): tools/economia/ — a game economy as data (almacén/pool, fuente/source, sumidero/drain, conversor, puerta/gate, registro/register, activador, disparador) simulated N ticks with the core's seeded RNG; models of Numinia's Tabla de Prestigio and Reliquias drop rate in tools/economia/modelos/; `node tools/economia.ts prestigio|reliquias`; method notes ../mmo-browser-study/MAQUINACIONES-APRENDIZAJE.md. [tools/economia/README.md]
Fighting (lucha v1, L1): features/lucha (a creature is a state entry with coherence, a mode and a solid box the simulation honours through `solido`+bx0…bz1; `golpear { objetivo }` → the server checks `within`, one blow per 12 ticks per player, damage 3-5 from the seeded PRNG, `golpe`/`aire`/`disuelta`/`vuelve`; the page draws the house block scaled to the box through view.place and flashes it). Sheets in bestiario.ts (one: Guardián de Crisálida); a world brings its own in MUNDO_DIR/lucha.json. PVE only; the creature does not move yet. Design: mmo-browser-study/SISTEMA-DE-LUCHA-Y-BESTIARIO.md.
Inventory (Y1): features/inventario (reglas.ts pure rules: 1 weapon + 3 relics carried, tokens stack by colour, Reserva of 24 per guest in api.store `i:<id>`; other features give objects by emitting their own `otorga` event with scope "server" — misiones does it for a `{ "tipo": "semilla" }` reward); panel apps/plaza/inventario.ts (R), summary in the sheet. docs/EXTENDER.md «El Inventario».
Parity with Hyperfy2, capability by capability: docs/HYPERFY2-PARIDAD.md.
AGENTS.md (binding rules), docs/SABER.md (what the project learned: decisions, measurements, rules, open questions — read before designing), docs/MAPA.md (where things live), docs/BACKLOG.md (queue), docs/RUNLOG.md (diary), docs/MOVIL-FRIO.md (mobile heat).
